current.title: Control-room "needs attention" dashboard: one prioritized live view of active SOS alerts, teams past their station time cap, paused/closed stations, and pending judge reviews
current.notes: VERIFIED ABSENT on topographic-maps (no control-room/triage page exists). New admin page + nav entry for the manager role. Read-ONLY aggregation of EXISTING live sources (adminAlerts snapshot, listPendingArrivals, listTeams, task status + maxDurationMinutes) — add NO new gameState/score writes, reuse the existing acknowledge action. Bilingual EN/HE + RTL logical classes + the premium theme.
acceptanceCriteria: A new admin route (e.g. /control) is reachable from the top nav and gated to the manager/admin role via roles.tsx canAccess
The page shows distinct prioritized sections: Active SOS alerts, Teams over their station time cap, Paused/closed stations, and Pending judge reviews count
Each row deep-links or routes to the relevant existing page (Manager for SOS/stations, Judge/Check-ins for reviews) so the organizer can act
The view auto-refreshes (usePoll, ~10-15s) and renders clean empty states ('All clear') when a section has nothing
Sections collapse/hide gracefully and the whole screen has loading + error states; existing pages are unchanged
All new copy is bilingual EN/HE via the admin i18n dictionary and uses logical RTL classes
implementationHints: Add apps/admin/src/pages/ControlRoomPage.tsx; register the route in apps/admin/src/App.tsx and add a NAV_ITEMS entry + i18n key
Gate access in apps/admin/src/roles.tsx (ROLE_ROUTES) for manager/admin; consider making it the manager default home
Reuse callable<>() from services/api.ts and usePoll from hooks/usePoll.ts; do NOT hand-roll httpsCallable

SOS alerts + station status come from the same sources ManagerPage already reads; time-cap logic mirrors JudgePage's Task.maxDurationMinutes warning; pending reviews from listPendingArrivals / StationReviewPage
Import shared callable-result types from @rushpoint/shared (TeamSummary, PendingArrival, StationTeamRow) — don't redeclare
Add EN/HE strings to apps/admin/src/i18n and keep tokens/glass theme consistent with other pages
current.rationale: On event day the organizer has no single place to see what is going wrong right now — they must hop between the Manager, Check-ins, Station and Matchmaking pages to notice an active SOS, a team stuck past its station cap, a paused/closed station, or a backlog of pending judge reviews. A prioritized live 'needs attention' view turns scattered polling into one glanceable triage screen, directly improving organizer control and event-day reliability. It composes data from callables that already exist, so risk is bounded and it preserves all current pages.
current.whyBeatAlternatives: It is the highest-scored candidate (57) and uniquely improves real-time organizer control on event day, whereas H-REG/H-OFFLINE/H-DASH each polish one player edge case; the control room reduces the chance the whole event goes sideways unnoticed.
current.visibleValue: An organizer opens one screen and immediately sees, ranked by urgency, every active SOS alert, every team past its station time cap, every paused/closed station, and the count of pending judge reviews — with deep links to act on each.
